detail.longDescription: Linux Mint 27 beta, codenamed "Adrien", is out for testing. It is the first release in Mint's new yearly cycle. What stands out: • Cinnamon 6.8 with Wayland now treated as fully supported • Linux kernel 7.0 on an Ubuntu 26.04 base • New apps: Clockenstein, Velocitty, Superlight, Unfold, Xepub • LTS with security updates until 2031 It's a beta, so use a VM or spare PC. Stable is planned for around Christmas. https://www. opensourcefeed.org/linux-mint- 27-beta-release/ # LinuxMint # Linux # Cinnamon # Wayland # OpenSource # FOSS
